note: Fits the profile cleanly on everything except money. He is a Michelin-level head chef running a brigade of about 25 and stepping into an ownership role, health is plainly the neglected corner of an otherwise ascending life, and at 68 kg with six years of kettlebell exposure he is the opposite of the deconditioned exclusion — he wants good to great, not rescue. But 'makes good money' fails on the liquidity test the ICP is actually reaching for: he could not put anything down on the day, said his funds were locked, was waiting on a payday, and had budgeted nothing for coaching. This is the third case in the corpus where a prospect fits on profile and misses on discretionary cash, and where a real instalment plan rather than an improvised deposit might have carried the deal.
